args.title: Freight Pricing Q1 2026 — Combined Summary (Ironbark blog + companion)
args.body:
- Spot rates fell 9% this quarter, while contract rates held steady.
- Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.

Sources: https://blog.ironbark.example/2026/freight and https://insights.ironbark.example/freight/companion (companion accessed via free registration with lucas.nakamura@northwind.example).
